leadText: The Unbearable Suspense of... THE GHOSTSTORY!!! (BOO!) (Japanese: 怪談でドッキドキ!!!! The Suspense of the Ghost Story!!!!) is the ninth bonus chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.
plainText:
The Unbearable Suspense of... THE GHOSTSTORY!!! (BOO!) (Japanese: 怪談でドッキドキ!!!! The Suspense of the Ghost Story!!!!) is the ninth bonus chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
Gathered around a candle at Grandpa and Coconut's house, Almond tells everyone else a ghost story. In the story, four things happen before the appearance of a ghost: the light of a candle being extinguished, the wind blowing through the windows, a strange dripping sound coming from nowhere, and a locked door opening by itself. After that, a woman's bloody face appears in the air. 

The Pokémon all scream after hearing the story, startling Almond. He and Hazel decide it is time to return home, and when Almond leaves, refuses to leave his side. Hazel is about to leave as well, but all of the Pokémon are still terrified, especially , who is unable to move. then suggests for everyone to stay over, telling Hazel to sleep in Coconut's room and borrow her pajamas.

After Hazel goes to bed, the Pokémon—except for an unbothered —find themselves unable to sleep. As time passes, they begin to hear the wind blowing from the other side of the window and the dripping of the rain. Despite being nervous itself, scolds everyone for getting anxious over a rainstorm. Shortly after the group continues trying to sleep, they hear dripping coming from within the room. As the sound gets louder and louder, Charmander panics, blowing fire all over the room and burning Coconut's belongings.

The Pokémon try to sleep again, but they suddenly hear the door handle being jostled. The door begins to open, and Pikachu unleashes a powerful attack. They see a shadow in the doorway, horrifying everyone. As the Pokémon all huddle together, Hazel moves in her sleep and falls over them. Right at that moment, Eevee sees a woman's bloody face appear over Hazel. Panicking, Eevee tosses one of Coconut's experiments at it, which proceeds to blow up the entire house.

Almond and Squirtle come across the wreckage of the home, finding a dazed Grandpa, who had apparently tried to check on the Pokémon in their room after hearing some noise. While Hazel and all the Pokémon are charred, Jigglypuff remains peacefully asleep. Meanwhile, Coconut makes her way back home, carrying a gift for Eevee. 

==Major events==
Coconut's house is destroyed yet again.
